# Heyu

This mod adds heyu to homeassistant, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `homeassistant` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:homeassistant-heyu
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:homeassistant-heyu|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

# Mod config instructions

Heyu cannot be configured through the homeassistant interface. To configure heyu edit the config file at `/config/heyu/x10.conf`

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/homeassistant-heyu/
